zeal.definition: n. excessive fervor to do something or accomplish some end
zeal.translation: n. 热心, 热衷, 热诚

examples.en: Zeal for your house will consume me.
examples.zh: 我为你的殿，心里焦急，如同火烧。

zealous.definition: s marked by active interest and enthusiasm
zealous.translation: a. 热衷的, 热诚的, 热心的, 热情的

examples.en: He is very zealous in his study of English.
The only thing worse than an idiot is a zealous idiot.
She was a zealous worker for charity.

zenith.definition: n. the point above the observer that is directly opposite the nadir on the imaginary sphere against which celestial bodies appear to be projected

examples.en: His fame was at its zenith at that time.
He is at the zenith of his glory.
The bright moon was at its zenith.

zero.definition:
n. a mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number
n. the point on a scale from which positive or negative numerical quantities can be measured
n. the sight setting that will cause a projectile to hit the center of the target with no wind blowing
v. adjust (an instrument or device) to zero value
zero.translation:
n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点
a. 零的, 没有的
vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正
[计] 零

examples.en: Because of his score of zero, he didn't dare to return.
examples.zh: 因为考了零分，所有不敢回去。

examples.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
examples.zh: 他们在无重力状态下进行了一连串的实验。

examples.en: The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上温度降到了零下。

wnsyn.desc: a mathematical element that when added to another number yields the same number
indicating the absence of any or all units under consideration
the point on a scale from which positive or negative numerical quantities can be measured

zigzag.definition: n. an angular shape characterized by sharp turns in alternating directions\nv. travel along a zigzag path\ns. having short sharp turns or angles
zigzag.translation:
n. 曲折线条, Z字形道路
a. 之字形的, 曲折的, 锯齿形的
adv. 之字形地, 曲折地, 成锯齿形地
vt. 使成之字形, 使曲折进行
vi. 成之字形, 弯曲地走路

examples.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
examples.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

examples.en: Tom zigzagged between the cars.
examples.zh: 汤姆在车流中来回穿行。

wnsyn.desc: an angular shape characterized by sharp turns in alternating directions
having short sharp turns or angles

zip.definition:
n a quantity of no importance
n a code of letters and digits added to a postal address to aid in the sorting of mail
n forceful exertion
n a fastener for locking together two toothed edges by means of a sliding tab
v close with a zipper
v move very fast
zip.translation: n. 尖啸声, 拉链, 活力\nvt. 给...以速度, 使增加活力, 拉(拉链)\nvi. 有力而迅速地行动, 嘘嘘地响, 拉拉链

examples.en: This zipper doesn't zip smoothly.
examples.zh: 这拉链卡卡的。

examples.en: My zip is stuck.
examples.zh: 我的拉链卡住了。

examples.en: He zipped open his bag.
examples.zh: 他拉开了包的拉链。

zone.definition:
n. a locally circumscribed place characterized by some distinctive features
n. any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude
n. an area or region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic
n. (anatomy) any encircling or beltlike structure
zone.translation:
n. 地带, 带, 地区
vt. 环绕, 使分成地带
vi. 分成区
[计] 卡片顶部的三行区; 区; 区域

examples.en: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
examples.zh: 你需要离开你的舒适区。

examples.en: It's like a war zone there.
examples.zh: 那里就像战场一样。

examples.en: That's a no-entry zone.
examples.zh: 那一带是禁区。

phrase.cn: 经济特区；经济圈；经济地带

wnsyn.desc: any of the regions of the surface of the Earth loosely divided according to latitude or longitude

zoo.definition: n the facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition

examples.en: I am taking my son to the zoo this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我今天下午带我儿子去动物园。

examples.en: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?
examples.zh: 你今天下午想不想去动物园？

examples.en: Jimmy insisted on my taking him to the zoo.
examples.zh: 吉米坚持要我带他去动物园。

zoom.definition: v. move along very quickly\nv. move with a low humming noise
zoom.translation:
n. 急速上升, 变焦摄影, 嗡嗡声
vi. 猛增, 急速上升, 摄象机移动
vt. 使摄象机移动
[计] 缩放

examples.en: Double click the map to zoom in on a place.
Leon and his friends decided to hold a Zoom reunion.
Leon told Amelia about a new app called Zoom.

zinc.definition: n. a bluish-white lustrous metallic element; brittle at ordinary temperatures but malleable when heated; used in a wide variety of alloys and in galvanizing iron; it occurs naturally as zinc sulphide in zinc blende\nv. coat or cover with zinc

examples.en: They mine one ore of zinc and another of copper.
Algeria has oil, gas, iron, gold, zinc, phosphates and much more.
Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

zodiac.definition: n. a belt-shaped region in the heavens on either side to the ecliptic; divided into 12 constellations or signs for astrological purposes\nn. (astrology) a circular diagram representing the 12 zodiacal constellations and showing their signs
zodiac.translation: n. 黄道带, 黄道十二宫图

examples.en: Many people ask why there is no cat among the twelve zodiac animals.
examples.zh: 很多人都会问，生肖的十二种动物里为什么没有猫呢？

examples.en: The reason there is no cat among the twelve zodiac animals is simple.
examples.zh: 十二生肖里没有猫的原因很简单。

examples.en: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
examples.zh: 生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。

zebra.definition: n. any of several fleet black-and-white striped African equines

examples.en: If you hear hoofbeats, don't look for zebras.
examples.zh: 不要听风就是雨。

examples.en: Zebra shadows don't have stripes.
examples.zh: 斑马的影子没有条纹。

examples.en: Is this zebra yours?
examples.zh: 这匹斑马是你的吗？

zipper.definition: n a fastener for locking together two toothed edges by means of a sliding tab\nv close with a zipper

examples.en: This zipper doesn't zip smoothly.
examples.zh: 这拉链卡卡的。

examples.en: My zipper got stuck.
examples.zh: 我的拉链卡住了。

zoological.definition: a. concerning the study of animals and their classification and properties\na. of or relating to animals or animal groups

examples.en: Public aviaries are often found in parks and zoological gardens.
The whale belongs to the zoological order of mammals.
Over 50 baboons have escaped from the Paris Zoological Park.

zoology.definition: n. the branch of biology that studies animals
zoology.translation: n. 动物学, 动物区系\n[医] 动物学

examples.en: Zoology and botany are dedicated to the study of life.
Zoology and botany deal with the study of life.
Zoology and botany are about the study of life.

wnsyn.desc: the branch of biology that studies animals
